quranTranslation.text: And when Abraham and Ishmael were raising the foundations of the House, (Abraham prayed): Our Lord! Accept from us (this duty). Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Hearer, the Knower.

explanation.bs: Ibrahim i Ismail podižu temelje Kuće.
explanation.en: Abraham and Ishmael raise the foundations of the House.

quranTranslation.text: And Allah hath given you in your houses an abode, and hath given you (also), of the hides of cattle, houses which ye find light (to carry) on the day of migration and on the day of pitching camp; and of their wool and their fur and their hair, caparison and comfort for a while.

explanation.bs: Allah vam je kuće vaše učinio mjestom smiraja (سَكَن).
explanation.en: Allah has made for you from your homes a place of rest (سَكَن).

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Enter not houses other than your own without first announcing your presence and invoking peace upon the folk thereof. That is better for you, that ye may be heedful.

explanation.bs: „Ne ulazite u kuće koje nisu vaše dok se ne najavite.“
explanation.en: “Enter not houses other than your own without first announcing your presence.”

quranTranslation.text: This life of the world is but a pastime and a game. Lo! the home of the Hereafter - that is Life, if they but knew.

explanation.bs: „A dom onoga svijeta – on je, zaista, pravi život“ – الدَّارُ الْآخِرَةُ.
explanation.en: “Lo! the home of the Hereafter — that is Life” — الدَّارُ الْآخِرَةُ.

quranTranslation.text: So the earthquake seized them, and morning found them prostrate in their dwelling-place.

explanation.bs: I osvanuše u domu svome mrtvi, nepomični – Semudćani.
explanation.en: And they became within their home corpses fallen prone — the people of Thamūd.

quranTranslation.text: Those who entered the city and the faith before them love those who flee unto them for refuge, and find in their breasts no need for that which hath been given them, but prefer (the fugitives) above themselves though poverty become their lot. And whoso is saved from his own avarice - such are they who are successful.

explanation.bs: Oni koji su prije njih Medinu nastanili – tefsir: دَار je ovdje grad.
explanation.en: Those who were settled in the home before them — tafsir: the dār here is Medina.

quranTranslation.text: There was indeed a sign for Sheba in their dwelling-place: Two gardens on the right hand and the left (as who should say): Eat of the provision of your Lord and render thanks to Him. A fair land and an indulgent Lord!

explanation.bs: Saba je u svom prebivalištu imala znak.
explanation.en: There was for Sabaʾ in their dwelling place a sign.

quranTranslation.text: Till, when they reached the Valley of the Ants, an ant exclaimed: O ants! Enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his armies crush you, unperceiving.

explanation.bs: „O mravi, uđite u svoja prebivališta!“
explanation.en: “O ants! Enter your dwellings!”

quranTranslation.text: He will forgive you your sins and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, and pleasant dwellings in Gardens of Eden. That is the supreme triumph.

explanation.bs: Lijepi dvori u Džennetima Adna.
explanation.en: Pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence.

quranTranslation.text: And when We said unto the angels: Prostrate yourselves before Adam, they fell prostrate, all save Iblis. He demurred through pride, and so became a disbeliever.

explanation.bs: Iblis „odbi i uzoholi se“ – oholost kao odbijanje naredbe.
explanation.en: Iblis “demurred through pride” — arrogance as refusing a command.

quranTranslation.text: And your Lord hath said: Pray unto Me and I will hear your prayer. Lo! those who scorn My service, they will enter hell, disgraced.

explanation.bs: „Oni koji se ohole da Mi ibadet čine…“ – oholost pred ibadetom.
explanation.en: “Those who scorn My service…” — arrogance before worship.

quranTranslation.text: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride.

explanation.bs: Nuhov narod „ustrajaše i silno se uzoholiše“ – oholost pred poslanikom.
explanation.en: Noah's people “persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride” — arrogance before a messenger.

quranTranslation.text: He said: Then go down hence! It is not for thee to show pride here, so go forth! Lo! thou art of those degraded.

explanation.bs: Iblisu: „Nije tebi da se tu oholiš“ – oholost tamo gdje joj nije mjesto.
explanation.en: To Iblis: “It is not for thee to show pride here” — arrogance where it has no place.

quranTranslation.text: I shall turn away from My revelations those who magnify themselves wrongfully in the earth, and if they see each token believe it not, and if they see the way of righteousness choose it nor for (their) way, and if they see the way of error choose if for (their) way. That is because they deny Our revelations and are used to disregard them.

explanation.bs: „…one koji se na Zemlji bez prava ohole“ – oholost nad drugima.
explanation.en: “…those who magnify themselves wrongfully in the earth” — arrogance over others.

quranTranslation.text: He is Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah, the Sovereign Lord, the Holy One, Peace, the Keeper of Faith, the Guardian, the Majestic, the Compeller, the Superb. Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him).

explanation.bs: „…Onaj Koji sve podčinjava, Uzvišeni (الْمُتَكَبِّرُ)“ – Allahovo ime; istinska veličina pripada samo Njemu.
explanation.en: “…the Compeller, the Superb (الْمُتَكَبِّرُ)” — a name of Allah; true greatness is His alone.

quranTranslation.text: Moses said: Lo! I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every scorner who believeth not in a Day of Reckoning.

explanation.bs: Musa: „Ja se utječem svome i vašem Gospodaru od svakog oholog (مُتَكَبِّرٍ) koji u Dan obračuna ne vjeruje“ – ista riječ o čovjeku, pokudno.
explanation.en: Moses: “I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every scorner (مُتَكَبِّرٍ) who believeth not in a Day of Reckoning” — the same word of a man, in blame.

quranTranslation.text: Hast thou not seen how Allah wafteth the clouds, then gathereth them, then maketh them layers, and thou seest the rain come forth from between them; He sendeth down from the heaven mountains wherein is hail, and smiteth therewith whom He will, and averteth it from whom He will. The flashing of His lightning all but snatcheth away the sight.

explanation.bs: „Allah goni oblake, zatim ih spaja, zatim ih nagomila, pa vidiš kišu kako izlazi između njih“ – oblak koji nosi kišu.
explanation.en: “Allah wafteth the clouds, then gathereth them, then maketh them layers, and thou seest the rain come forth from between them” — the rain-bearing cloud.

quranTranslation.text: And He it is Who sendeth the winds as tidings heralding His mercy, till, when they bear a cloud heavy (with rain), We lead it to a dead land, and then cause water to descend thereon and thereby bring forth fruits of every kind. Thus bring We forth the dead. Haply ye may remember.

explanation.bs: „…kad ponesu teške oblake, Mi ih potjeramo u mrtav kraj“ – vjetrovi i oblaci.
explanation.en: “…when they bear a cloud heavy (with rain), We lead it to a dead land” — winds and clouds.

quranTranslation.text: And We caused the white cloud to overshadow you and sent down on you the manna and the quails, (saying): Eat of the good things wherewith We have provided you - they wronged Us not, but they did wrong themselves.

explanation.bs: „I nad vama smo oblake nadvili kao sjenu“ – oblak kao hlad u pustinji.
explanation.en: “And We caused the white cloud to overshadow you” — the cloud as shade in the desert.

quranTranslation.text: A day when the heaven with the clouds will be rent asunder and the angels will be sent down, a grand descent.

explanation.bs: „A na Dan kad se nebo s oblacima raspukne…“ – oblaci Sudnjeg dana.
explanation.en: “A day when the heaven with the clouds will be rent asunder…” — the clouds of the Last Day.

quranTranslation.text: Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder?

explanation.bs: „Spuštate li je vi iz kišnih oblaka ili Mi je spuštamo?“ – مُزْن kao izvor pitke vode.
explanation.en: “Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder?” — مُزْن as the source of drinking water.

quranTranslation.text: And when ye said: O Moses! We are weary of one kind of food; so call upon thy Lord for us that He bring forth for us of that which the earth groweth - of its herbs and its cucumbers and its corn and its lentils and its onions. He said: Would ye exchange that which is higher for that which is lower? Go down to settled country, thus ye shall get that which ye demand. And humiliation and wretchedness were stamped upon them and they were visited with wrath from Allah. That was because they disbelieved in Allah's revelations and slew the prophets wrongfully. That was for their disobedience and transgression.

explanation.bs: „I na njih je udareno poniženje i bijeda“ – poniženje kao kazna.
explanation.en: “And humiliation and wretchedness were stamped upon them” — abasement as punishment.

quranTranslation.text: And those who earn ill-deeds, (for them) requital of each ill-deed by the like thereof; and ignominy overtaketh them - They have no protector from Allah - as if their faces had been covered with a cloak of darkest night. Such are rightful owners of the Fire; they will abide therein.

explanation.bs: „…i prekrit će ih poniženje“ – poniženje kao kazna za one koji su činili zlo.
explanation.en: “…and ignominy overtaketh them” — abasement as the punishment of those who did evil.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Those who chose the calf (for worship), terror from their Lord and humiliation will come upon them in the life of the world. Thus do We requite those who invent a lie.

explanation.bs: „One koji su uzeli tele zaista će stići srdžba njihovog Gospodara i poniženje u ovosvjetskom životu.“
explanation.en: “Lo! Those who chose the calf (for worship), terror from their Lord and humiliation will come upon them in the life of the world.”

quranTranslation.text: And lower unto them the wing of submission through mercy, and say: My Lord! Have mercy on them both as they did care for me when I was little.

explanation.bs: „I spusti prema njima krilo poniznosti (جَنَاحَ الذُّلِّ) iz milosti“ – pohvalna poniznost.
explanation.en: “And lower unto them the wing of submission (جَنَاحَ الذُّلِّ) through mercy” — praised lowliness.

quranTranslation.text: And thou wilt see them exposed to (the Fire), made humble by disgrace, and looking with veiled eyes. And those who believe will say: Lo! the (eternal) losers are they who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Lo! are not the wrong-doers in perpetual torment?

explanation.bs: Nepravednici izvedeni pred Vatru, „skrušeni od poniženja“ – nametnuta poniznost.
explanation.en: The wrongdoers brought before the Fire, “made humble by disgrace” — imposed lowliness.

quranTranslation.text: And say: Praise be to Allah, Who hath not taken unto Himself a son, and Who hath no partner in the Sovereignty, nor hath He any protecting friend through dependence. And magnify Him with all magnificence.

explanation.bs: „…niti ima zaštitnika zbog nemoći (مِنَ الذُّلِّ)“ – Allah je slobodan od svake slabosti.
explanation.en: “…nor hath He any protecting friend through dependence (مِنَ الذُّلِّ)” — Allah is free of all weakness.

quranTranslation.text: And who doth greater wrong than he who forbiddeth the approach to the sanctuaries of Allah lest His name should be mentioned therein, and striveth for their ruin. As for such, it was never meant that they should enter them except in fear. Theirs in the world is ignominy and theirs in the Hereafter is an awful doom.

explanation.bs: „Za njih je na ovom svijetu sramota, a na onom svijetu velika kazna.“
explanation.en: “Theirs in the world is ignominy and theirs in the Hereafter is an awful doom.”

quranTranslation.text: Thus Allah made them taste humiliation in the life of the world, and verily the doom of the Hereafter will be greater if they did but know.

explanation.bs: „Pa im je Allah dao da okuse sramotu u životu na ovom svijetu.“
explanation.en: “Thus Allah made them taste humiliation in the life of the world.”

quranTranslation.text: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and will say: Where are My partners, for whose sake ye opposed (My guidance)? Those who have been given knowledge will say: Disgrace this day and evil are upon the disbelievers,

explanation.bs: „Danas su sramota i zlo zaista na nevjernicima“ – sramota na Sudnjem danu.
explanation.en: “Disgrace this day and evil are upon the disbelievers” — disgrace on the Day.

quranTranslation.text: Who hath appointed the earth a resting-place for you, and the sky a canopy; and causeth water to pour down from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you. And do not set up rivals to Allah when ye know (better).

explanation.bs: „… i spustio je s neba vodu pa njome izveo plodove kao opskrbu za vas“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
explanation.en: “… and causeth water to pour down from the sky, thereby producing fruits (مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ) as food for you” — ar-Rāġib quotes these words.

quranTranslation.text: He it is Who sendeth down water from the sky, and therewith We bring forth buds of every kind; We bring forth the green blade from which We bring forth the thick-clustered grain; and from the date-palm, from the pollen thereof, spring pendant bunches; and (We bring forth) gardens of grapes, and the olive and the pomegranate, alike and unlike. Look upon the fruit thereof, when they bear fruit, and upon its ripening. Lo! herein verily are portents for a people who believe.

explanation.bs: „Pogledajte njegov plod kad zarodi, i njegovo sazrijevanje!“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Look upon the fruit thereof, when they bear fruit, and upon its ripening” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And he had fruit. And he said unto his comrade, when he spake with him: I am more than thee in wealth, and stronger in respect of men.

explanation.bs: „I imao je plodova (ثَمَر)“ – ar-Rāġib prenosi da je Ibn Abbas to razumio kao imetak.
explanation.en: “And he had fruit (ثَمَر)” — ar-Rāġib reports that Ibn ʿAbbās understood it as wealth.

quranTranslation.text: Wherein is fruit, the date-palm and pomegranate.

explanation.bs: „U njima su voće, i palme, i šipci“ – na ovome počiva mišljenje da voće ne obuhvata šipak.
explanation.en: “Wherein is fruit, the date-palm and pomegranate” — the view that fruit excludes the pomegranate rests on this.

quranTranslation.text: Therein for you is fruit in plenty whence to eat.

explanation.bs: „U njemu za vas ima mnogo voća od kojeg ćete jesti“ – voće u Džennetu.
explanation.en: “Therein for you is fruit in plenty whence to eat” — fruit in Paradise.

quranTranslation.text: And fruits and grasses:

explanation.bs: „I voće i trava“ – mjesto gdje je voće ovoga svijeta, a ne Dženneta.
explanation.en: “And fruits and grasses” — a place where fruit is of this world, not of Paradise.

quranTranslation.text: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,

explanation.bs: „Ondje će biti napajani peharom (كَأْس) čija je primjesa đumbir“ – posuda s pićem; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “There are they watered with a cup (كَأْس) whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil [ginger]” — the vessel with its drink; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.

explanation.bs: „U njemu će jedni drugima dodavati pehar (كَأْس) u kojem nema ni besmislice ni grijeha.“
explanation.en: “There they pass from hand to hand a cup (كَأْس) wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.”

quranTranslation.text: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass

explanation.bs: „I kružit će se među njima sa srebrenim posudama i čašama (أَكْوَاب) koje su kao staklo.“
explanation.en: “Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (أَكْوَاب) (as) of glass.”
